title: Three Dead Men
prompt: Three dead men are sitting at a table in a room. On the table there are playing cards and a gun. What happened?
solution: Two of the men shot themselves in the head, and the third suffocated. The room is in a submarine lying motionless on the sea bottom. The men had a gun with only two bullets. When there was very little air left, they decided to gamble: the winners got the right to shoot themselves, and the loser had to suffocate slowly, in the company of two corpses.
